outcome.description: After a four-day January 2018 trial the Court of Claims credited the State's appraiser (with its own adjustments, preappropriation value $52,339 per acre or $1,662,810), found the western remainder's post-taking highest and best use was multifamily residential, and awarded KKS $744,500 in direct and consequential damages. The Third Department affirmed the amended judgment on October 29, 2020. (An earlier award of $532,000 had been reversed in 2014.)

source.caseName: Matter of Acquisition of Real Property by the State of New York (KKS Properties, LLC, claimant)
source.court: Supreme Court of the State of New York, Appellate Division, Third Department, on appeal from the Court of Claims
source.excerptNote: Verbatim from the background (property, 2006 appropriation, prior proceedings) and the decision's descriptions of the parties' trial evidence (both appraisers' preappropriation valuations, the State appraiser's post-taking multifamily testimony, the claimant's access argument and engineer's opinion). Removed: the sentence reporting the first trial's award (reversed in 2014), the sentence reporting the 2018 award, the Court of Claims' findings (its own per-acre value and treatment of each appraisal), footnotes and all appellate reasoning. Two sentences are cut at a semicolon before the court's evaluation of them (the cut is marked by a period), so their second halves are omitted. The decision does not state either appraiser's after-taking value or damages total. Official reporter copy: 2020 NY Slip Op 06185.
